description: List the credited cast of a show with the characters they play, optionally with crew; or list the guest cast of one episode, optionally with its guest crew such as the director and writers. Results are paged: cast rows come first, then crew rows, and each page splits them back into cast and crew. The source records no recurring-versus-guest distinction on a show’s cast list, so a name’s absence from it does not mean the performer never appeared — check an episode’s guest cast for that.

cursor.description: Continuation token from a previous call’s next_cursor. It carries only the position to resume from; the page size comes from limit. Omit for the first page.

include_crew.description: Also list the show’s crew credits — producers, creators, and other series-level roles, with no episode attribution. Off by default; a long-running series carries hundreds and they are rarely what a cast question is asking for.

limit.description: Maximum credits to return in this call, cast and crew together. Applies to every page, including a call that passes cursor. A long-running series carries over a thousand cast credits.

show_id.description: TVmaze show id, from tvmaze_search_shows, tvmaze_lookup_show, or tvmaze_get_schedule.

cursor.description: Continuation token from a previous call’s next_cursor. It carries only the position to resume from; the page size comes from limit. Omit for the first page.

episode_id.description: TVmaze episode id, from tvmaze_get_episodes, tvmaze_get_next_episode, tvmaze_get_schedule, or tvmaze_get_show.

include_crew.description: Also list the episode’s guest crew — who directed and wrote it, as TVmaze credits them. Off by default.

limit.description: Maximum credits to return in this call, cast and crew together. Applies to every page, including a call that passes cursor. A long-running series carries over a thousand cast credits.

name: tvmaze_get_cast

cap.description: The page size applied to this call — its limit.

cast.description: Cast credits on this page — for scope "show", the main cast; for scope "episode", that episode’s guest cast. Empty on a page past the last cast row.

as_self.description: True when the performer appears as themselves rather than a character.

character_name.description: Character played. Absent on a crew credit.

character_url.description: Canonical TVmaze page for the character.

credit_type.description: Crew role, e.g. "Executive Producer". Present only on crew credits.

person_image_url.description: Performer headshot URL at original resolution.

person_url.description: Canonical TVmaze page for the performer. Include it when citing or displaying this record.

voice_only.description: True when the role is voice-only.

crew.description: Crew credits on this page — for scope "show", the show’s crew; for scope "episode", that episode’s guest crew. Present, possibly empty, whenever include_crew was set; crew rows follow every cast row, so a page that ends inside the cast carries none.

as_self.description: True when the performer appears as themselves rather than a character.

character_name.description: Character played. Absent on a crew credit.

character_url.description: Canonical TVmaze page for the character.

credit_type.description: Crew role, e.g. "Executive Producer". Present only on crew credits.

person_image_url.description: Performer headshot URL at original resolution.

person_url.description: Canonical TVmaze page for the performer. Include it when citing or displaying this record.

voice_only.description: True when the role is voice-only.

crew_total.description: Crew credits across every page. Present when include_crew was set.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `show_not_found`: No show exists with the given TVmaze id. `episode_not_found`: No episode exists with the given TVmaze id. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_more.description: True when more credits remain beyond this page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page. Absent on the last page.

notice.description: Guidance when the page was truncated, or when no cast is recorded — every one that applies, joined. Absent otherwise.

shown.description: Number of credits returned on this page.

subject_id.description: TVmaze id the credits belong to — a show id or an episode id, matching scope.

totalCount.description: Credits across every page, cast plus crew.

truncated.description: True when the page limit was reached.

title: Tvmaze Get Cast
